title: Learning to Be Guided: Shaping Latent Geometry for Classifier-Free Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2610.22885v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Classifier-free guidance (CFG) is a standard component of conditional diffusion models, and guided generation performance has become the \textit{de facto} measure of state-of-the-art models. Recent work on latent diffusion models seeks to learn latent spaces that are easier to model with diffusion. However, under CFG, generation additionally depends on how conditions are arranged in the latent space. We study this arrangement under discrete class conditions, termed \emph{class geometry}, and investigate what class geometry allows a latent space to work well with CFG. Under a Gaussian class model, we show that shifting variance from intra- to inter-class at fixed total variance makes classes more distinguishable under noise, and derive a noisy posterior objective whose per-sample descent direction is proportional to the oracle CFG correction. translated_title: 学会被引导：面向无分类器引导的潜在空间几何塑造
translated_abstract: 无分类器引导是条件扩散模型的标准组成部分，引导生成性能已成为衡量最先进模型的事实标准。近期关于潜在扩散模型的研究致力于学习更容易用扩散过程建模的潜在空间。然而，在CFG下，生成效果还取决于条件在潜在空间中的排列方式。我们在离散类别条件下研究了这种排列方式，称之为“类别几何”，并探究什么样的类别几何能使潜在空间与CFG良好协同工作。在高斯类别模型下，我们证明在总方差固定的情况下，将方差从类内转移到类间可以使各类别在噪声下更易区分，并推导出一个噪声后验目标，其逐样本的下降方向与oracle CFG修正成正比。基于这一分析，我们提出了原型正则化，这是一种轻量级的替代方法（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 本文提出原型正则化方法，通过在潜在空间中塑造“类间方差大于类内方差”的类别几何结构，使潜在空间天然适配无分类器引导（CFG），从而提升条件扩散模型的引导生成性能。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Prototype Regularization, a lightweight method that shapes the class geometry of latent spaces by maximizing inter-class variance over intra-class variance, making latent diffusion models inherently well-suited to classifier-free guidance (CFG).
